task.question: In classical music, who was placed on leave until September 30, 2026, by the Salzburg Festival on March 26, 2026?
task.evidence: 26 March – The board of directors of the Salzburg Festival announce the termination of the contract of Markus Hinterhäuser as artistic director of the festival, placing him on leave until 30 September 2026.

On March 26, 2026, Markus Hinterhäuser, the Artistic Director of the Salzburg Festival, was placed on leave until September 30, 2026. This decision was made due to irreconcilable differences of opinion between him and the festival's supervisory board. 

FINAL: Markus Hinterhäuser.
